comments: Methodology and limitations: https://krsi.pl/metodologia/ . Public reports cover the tested URL at the recorded measurement date, rather than all pages of a website. The interface and reports are in Polish. Automated accessibility results are not a declaration of WCAG A, AA or AAA conformance.
features: KRSI is a Polish public registry of automated website measurements. It combines Lighthouse accessibility checks with additional local rules, reports potential issues and an accessibility score, and also records performance, SEO and SSL/TLS results. Automated results support manual evaluation and do not establish full WCAG conformance.
title: KRSI — Krajowy Rejestr Stron Internetowych
